svg.text: config/products/<id>.yaml · validated at startup · no product names in code
names · glossary · fixed replies · prompt [[placeholders]] · KB namespaces + scopes · sitemaps · UI texts
id → alias → host → API key → default
out of scope · no access → reply
all providers down → static support reply + sources
red dashed = refusal / fallback path: a fixed, safe reply goes straight back to the client (never an unverified answer)
approved answers + eval cases → index and eval gate
all self-hosted and free · Langfuse off
